description: Use when the user asks about recent federal contracts, government awards, or who won a U.S. federal contract. Returns newly signed federal awards, newest first; `min_amount` sets a USD floor, `days` a last-N-days window. Every award carries its source award_url. Caveat: awards without a source link are dropped and never returned.

days.description: Only awards signed within the last N days.

limit.description: Max rows to return (default 25, newest first). Page with offset; the response's total_matched shows the full count. limit<=0 = no cap.

min_amount.description: Only awards at or above this USD amount

offset.description: Rows to skip before this page (pagination). Default 0.

name: federal_awards_recent
title: Recent U.S. federal contract awards (USAspending.gov)
